correctness.rationale: The root-edge degree formula gives an exact K2/P3/singleton correspondence. The two maximality alternatives are necessary and sufficient under every omitted edge, with disjoint counting. Labeled exponential formulas, coefficient support, finite exceptional orders, and strictly decreasing adjacent ratios (including corrected top) prove the theorem for every n>=2. The standalone graph-level verifier independently checks 2,555,347 candidates through n=9, with exhaustive full subset checks through n=6 and coefficient-ratio arithmetic through n=200; these are corroboration only.

value.rationale: This is a complete labeled cardinality census of both arbitrary and inclusion-maximal induced maximum-degree-one subsets on canonical strongly regular triangular graphs. The exceptional one-unused-vertex class changes maximal counts, produces exact gap-free cardinality spectra, yields strict coefficient log-concavity and a nontrivial all-maximal-same-size exception at n=7. The result is not merely the known maximum size, and the finite computations are not presented as the mathematical contribution.
